la:verb:perquiro.gloss: to ask, inquire or search diligently
senses: to ask, inquire or search diligently
la:verb:perquiro.html:
per-quīro, sīvi, sītum, 3, v. a.
quaero
.
To ask or inquire after diligently, to make diligent search for any thing: perquirunt, quid causae siet,: vasa,; cf. , § 134; : a contemplandis rebus perquirendisque deterreri,: aditus viasque in Suevos perquirit,; .— Absol.: perquirite et videte si, etc.,make inquiry,.—Impers. pass.: perquiritur a coactoribus,. —
To examine: cognitionem rei,.—Hence, perquīsītē, adv., exactly, accurately; in comp.: perquisitius conscribere,.

la:adv:perquam.gloss: as much as possible, extremely, exceedingly

la:adv:perquam.html:
per-quam, adv. (also, less correctly, written separately, per quam, v. per
fin.), as much as possible, extremely, exceedingly: illorum mores perquam meditate tenes,: perquam indignis modis,: perquam breviter,: perquam modica,: perquam velim scire,: parentes perquam infelicissimi,: sagax,. —In tmesi: per pol quam paucos reperias,.
